title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 2, Fugue 15 in G major

character.text: Light sonata fugue (Spielfuge), the closest of the 48 to a partimento fugue

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of the subject (2 times). Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: the opening of the subject (3 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times).
sections.leads: From G major to E minor

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bar 14) in part, with the alto's line in the bass, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Soprano: a figure from the subject. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times).
sections.leads: From E minor to B minor

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bar 14) in part, with the soprano's line in the bass, the alto's line in the soprano, transposed. Soprano: a figure from the subject (4 times), in a sequence falling by a third every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a third every two bars. Bass: a figure from the subject (3 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a fifth every two bars.
sections.leads: From B minor to G major

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times).

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times). Returns in Episode 2 (bar 39). Returns in Episode 3 (bars 45–64).
